capabilities: Sync highlights from Screvi automatically on an interval
Organize highlights into notes by source type
Authenticate with a Screvi API key
disambiguation: Not a file or device sync tool; 'sync' here means importing highlights from the Screvi service into the vault.
extras: Requires an active Screvi trial or subscription; README states the plugin contacts only api.screvi.com with no analytics or telemetry.
problem: Highlights collected across reading platforms like Kindle and Kobo need a way to land in Obsidian as organized Markdown notes.

relations.evidence: Sync your Screvi highlights into Obsidian.

summary: Syncs reading highlights from the Screvi service into your vault as Markdown notes organized by source type.
